_about_shops: Shops with an "actor" can be checked by the Apify robot (the GitHub job). Shops with a "browser" block can be checked by the home price checker (price-checker/check_prices.py). Asda and Waitrose have no robot on purpose: their sites block automated visits. Iceland was added to the Apify robot in October 2026.
